title: PEMEX Deer Park Chemical Release
outcome: Two fatalities; 13 others transported to medical facilities; more than 27,000 pounds of hydrogen sulfide released.
lesson: Before pipe opening, positively identify the exact equipment and communicate unit hazards and safeguards to every contractor. Assess nearby personnel exposure and verify isolation rather than relying on similar-looking equipment or incomplete markings.
source: U.S. Chemical Safety and Hazard Investigation Board final investigation report and release

title: Bio-Lab Conyers Fire and Chemical Release
event_type: Reactive chemical decomposition, fires, and toxic gas release
outcome: Warehouse destroyed; no injuries reported at the site; community evacuation and shelter-in-place actions followed.
lesson: Treat storage compatibility, moisture exposure, corrosion, and fire-protection system condition as interacting hazards. Resolve recurring equipment degradation and reassess safeguards against actual inventory and process conditions.
source: U.S. Chemical Safety and Hazard Investigation Board final investigation report and release
